about: Store-approved 'rate this game' prompt (Google Play In-App Review / Apple requestReview) via the Godot In-App Review plugin (MIT). On, but it does nothing until the plugin is in the build (tools/store_addons/install_store_addons.sh, see stores/IN_APP_REVIEW.md), and Google only shows the card in copies installed from Google Play. Asks after a podium finish, never from a button. The stores also limit how often the dialog really shows. Set enabled to false to switch it off.
